name: Told to hush, Boop is quiet for a while, and sulks a little
case: Nothing is working. The person tells Boop to be quiet: it replies hush, and it sulks: its mood turns cross. For the next half hour Talk is quiet: it still makes faces at a poke and at a finished turn, but says nothing at these small moments. Once the half hour is up, a poke gets something said again. Later the app's Hush button makes it quiet again, with no pass of its own; then the person talks to it, which ends the quiet, and a poke gets something said again.
why: MomentOutput: a hush reply makes Talk quiet for half an hour (Core.quiet), and on Quiet a small moment or a finish says nothing; talking to Boop ends it (Pipeline.said); PERSONALITY: told to hush, it sulks, whatever the mood: cross
